title: SongPal Wish Echoed
style: warped funky soul, glitch pop, ambient techno, dark synths, sultry voice, ethereal electro, pedal steel guitar, ad libs, infectious rhythm, vocal-driven, introspective, dreamy, glitchy textures, percussive, dramatic pop
lyrics:
[Intro — low warm pad, single bass note, water reverb]
(spoken, soft)
Heard your penny hit the water.
Heard the well was wet.
Tossing one back from the other side.
This one's for you.

[Verse 1]
Sunny day, parkin' lot, you said you got away
I'm late to the well but the ripples still play
Echo what you sent, echo what stayed
I'm not the one who left — I'm the one who heard

Heard the lingerin', heard the never-knew-you-could-care
Heard you wanted so bad, heard the empty air
Tossing pennies wherever wishes go
Tossing one for you, hope you know

[Pre-Chorus]
You threw a penny in a wishing well
The well was wet, the well still tells
I throw mine in after yours
And the only wish I make is —

[Chorus]
I wish whenever you wish, your wishes come true
Every penny you toss lands soft on the truth
Wet wells, dry pennies, full of you
I wish whenever you wish, your wishes come true

[Verse 2]
I don't know where you are but wherever wishes go
Mine just walked there asking after you
The well is full and the well is wet
Tossing in another, no regret

You wanted somebody so bad you wrote it down
You wrote it twice — once for the parkin' lot, once for now
I'm hearing it third — the echo of an echo
And the echo answers: hope you're doing well

[Bridge — half-time, glitchy textures, growl low]
Pegadiza, the well, the well
Sing it low, sing it high, the well, the well
Pedal steel cries, dubstep wobble, the well, the well
The only honest wish is the one you give away

[Final Chorus — full euphoric drop]
I wish whenever you wish, your wishes come true
Every penny you toss lands soft on the truth
Wet wells, dry pennies, full of you
I wish whenever you wish, your wishes come true

[Outro — fade with reversed water, sultry ad-libs]
(ad-libs)
Hope you're doing well...
Hope you're doing well...
The well is wet...
The well is full...
And the only wish is...
yours.
